text: Finally, deficiency diseases. Too little protein and energy: kwashiorkor, which swells with oedema, and marasmus, which shrinks to skin and bone. Vitamin A: night blindness. B one: beriberi. B three: pellagra, the three Ds, dermatitis, diarrhoea, dementia. C: scurvy. D: rickets. Iron: anaemia. And iodine: goitre, now rare in Nepal thanks to iodised salt.
